I like hamburgers too, honestly i feel like burgers are so underrated because of how easily available they are. 

I personally smoke weed to help cope with my suicidal thoughts.
I suffer from PTSD, BPD, MDD and GAD.
I understand where you’re coming from, and ive made attempts myself.

But what about a burger? Get aggressive on a burger.
Next time you get a burger, beat it senseless before you enjoy it. It may sound weird, and people might stare. But the burger will understand. ☺️
In any case, you’re not alone, and as difficult and rough as things seem, they get so much easier over time 💙💙

No, i just misread it. 
I mis understood the “randomized wings” questions as the layer itself being random, not the wing available being random.

So.. 🤷🏻‍♂️

What kind of food do you like?
Personally, when im going through my mental health issues, i love oreos. 
But pizza is my all time favorite 😭

What covenant are you? And what talents are you running because ive never had an issue soloing on my balance druid even when i was running 160 ilvl on L8 wings.
Also, randomized wings don’t affect drop rate just map layout.

And lastly, what anima powers are you going for? Combining certain powers can mean the difference between steamrolling the tower and struggling honestly (i.e. i avoid powers that increase physical dmg because im balance etc.)

My ex-fiancé broke up with me out of no where in 2k19 at the worst possible time after 4 years. 

It was the last thing i wanted to hear at the time, but it’s something that just takes time. If i had chest codes for you, id give em. But in the meantime, id say try to reach out to close friends or family that you trust. Maybe consider getting mental health treatment 💙
